messages:
Noah (AE): SilverCrest asks for a 6mo pilot on Private: 30% off list + waive setup. PO target next Wed.
Tara (RevOps): list for requested config?
Noah (AE): private VPC, reserved 1xA100 equiv, managed support = $85k/mo. 30% => $59.5k/mo.
Marta (Security): they uploaded questionnaire. Want lighter audit retention. We should require attestation before go-live.
Dev (Eng): we can do fast-start on shared infra for first 3 days, move to dedicated in ~10 business days.
Noah (AE): proposing two offers:
- Option A: 25% off for 6mo pilot, setup waived, conversion window 45d. Conversion credit = 50% of pilot invoices applied as dollar credit to first post-conversion invoice, cap $100k.
- Option B: 18% off for 12mo commit + $20k onboarding credit + $10k/mo compute credits.
Tara (RevOps): finance floor = 20% for pilots w/out firm commit. 25% needs conditional approval + PO deadline + security attestation.
Noah (AE): can we approve 25% if PO arrives by Wed (2765432124), conversion intent signed in pilot, and attestation uploaded within 7 days?
Marta (Security): yes, attach clause: "Waiver conditioned on completed attestation and allowlist within 7 days; service start subject to review."
LegalBot: recommend clarifying conversion credit: "dollar credit equal to 50% of total pilot invoices, capped at $100,000, applied to first post-conversion invoice."
Tara (RevOps): I'll file deal-desk ticket for conditional 25% approval and add margin guardrails. If any condition fails, discount voids.
Noah (AE): sending draft to customer now. Will update thread when PO lands. :crossed_fingers:
